description: Reservoir thermal breakthrough + permeability decline + ORC part-load + ambient derating

unit.name: Generic EGS Plant (Binary/ORC cycle)
unit.source: Tester et al. (2006) MIT/DOE; DiPippo (2015) Ch.16; Sanyal & Butler (2005)

eta_utilization.note: Slightly lower than natural geothermal (pump parasitic)

pump_parasitic_fraction_0.note: Initial pump parasitic fraction; 8-15% for EGS (Tester 2006)

pump_parasitic_max.note: Max pump fraction before project becomes uneconomic

T_reinject_offset.note: Reinjection T above ambient: min temp to avoid mineral precipitation

tau_thermal_yr.note: Thermal breakthrough time constant; 5-20 yr depending on fracture spacing (Tester 2006)

T_inject_degC.note: Water injection temperature; defines lower bound of thermal decline

c_perm_decline.note: Permeability decline coefficient; stress-induced fracture closure

delta_P_design_MPa.note: Design reservoir pressure differential (typical EGS: 3-10 MPa)

part_load_curve.note: ORC part-load curve (same as EC153 binary); DiPippo (2015)
